name: figma-local-bridge
description: Local MCP bridge for Figma: OpenCode <-> MCP(stdio) <-> WebSocket <-> Figma plugin

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:server && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.e2e.mjs
